2026-08-06.title: कैबिनेट ने GOBARdhan योजना को मंजूरी दी, 23731 करोड़ के बजट से चलेगी
bullets: कैबिनेट ने GOBARdhan योजना को मंजूरी दी है, जिसका उद्देश्य स्वच्छ ऊर्जा उत्पादन को बढ़ावा देना है। इस योजना के तहत, केंद्र सरकार 23731 करोड़ रुपये का बजट आवंटित करेगी।
GOBARdhan योजना के तहत, केंद्र सरकार 23731 करोड़ रुपये का बजट आवंटित करेगी, जिसमें से 15000 करोड़ रुपये का उपयोग गैस के उत्पादन के लिए किया जाएगा।
इस योजना का उद्देश्य स्वच्छ ऊर्जा उत्पादन को बढ़ावा देना है, जिससे भारत की ऊर्जा सुरक्षा में सुधार होगा।

2026-08-06.title: कैबिनेट ने Andhra Pradesh में PPP नीति और Ease of Doing Business Act को मंजूरी दी
bullets: कैबिनेट ने Andhra Pradesh में PPP नीति और Ease of Doing Business Act को मंजूरी दी है, जिसका उद्देश्य राज्य में उद्योगों को बढ़ावा देना है।
इस नीति के तहत, केंद्र सरकार Andhra Pradesh सरकार को 1000 करोड़ रुपये का अनुदान देगी, जिससे राज्य में उद्योगों को बढ़ावा मिलेगा।
Ease of Doing Business Act का उद्देश्य राज्य में उद्योगों को आसानी से शुरू करने के लिए आवश्यक प्रक्रियाओं को सरल बनाना है।

2026-08-06.title: कैबिनेट ने UDAN योजना को मंजूरी दी, शिमला-चंडीगढ़ रूट पर हेलीकॉप्टर उड़ानें शुरू होंगी
bullets: कैबिनेट ने UDAN योजना को मंजूरी दी है, जिसका उद्देश्य देश के छोटे हवाई अड्डों को बढ़ावा देना है।
इस योजना के तहत, शिमला-चंडीगढ़ रूट पर हेलीकॉप्टर उड़ानें शुरू होंगी, जिससे यात्रियों को आसानी से पहुंचने में मदद मिलेगी।
UDAN योजना का उद्देश्य देश के छोटे हवाई अड्डों को बढ़ावा देना है, जिससे यात्रियों को आसानी से पहुंचने में मदद मिलेगी।

2026-08-06.title: कैबिनेट ने रैयाम और सकरी चीनी मिलों के पुनर्जीवन को मंजूरी दी
bullets: कैबिनेट ने रैयाम और सकरी चीनी मिलों के पुनर्जीवन को मंजूरी दी है, जिसका उद्देश्य चीनी उत्पादन को बढ़ावा देना है।
इस योजना के तहत, केंद्र सरकार 500 करोड़ रुपये का अनुदान देगी, जिससे चीनी मिलों को पुनर्जीवित किया जा सकेगा।
चीनी मिलों के पुनर्जीवन से चीनी उत्पादन में वृद्धि होगी, जिससे देश की चीनी आवश्यकताओं को पूरा किया जा सकेगा।

2026-08-06.title: कैबिनेट ने गुवाहाटी से तेजपुर तक 8,970 करोड़ रुपये की सड़क परियोजना को मंजूरी दी
bullets: कैबिनेट ने गुवाहाटी से तेजपुर तक 8,970 करोड़ रुपये की सड़क परियोजना को मंजूरी दी है, जिसका उद्देश्य असम में सड़क नेटवर्क को मजबूत करना है।
इस परियोजना के तहत, 82 किलोमीटर लंबी सड़क बनाई जाएगी, जिससे गुवाहाटी और तेजपुर के बीच यात्रा की गति बढ़ेगी।
सड़क नेटवर्क को मजबूत करने से असम में व्यापार और उद्योगों को बढ़ावा मिलेगा, जिससे राज्य की अर्थव्यवस्था में वृद्धि होगी।

2026-08-06.title: कैबिनेट ने बिहार में 22,000 से अधिक आंगनबाड़ी सेविका-सहायिकाओं की बहाली को मंजूरी दी
bullets: कैबिनेट ने बिहार में 22,000 से अधिक आंगनबाड़ी सेविका-सहायिकाओं की बहाली को मंजूरी दी है, जिसका उद्देश्य बाल विकास कार्यक्रम को मजबूत करना है।
इस योजना के तहत, आंगनबाड़ी सेविका-सहायिकाओं को प्रशिक्षण दिया जाएगा, जिससे उन्हें बाल विकास कार्यक्रम को प्रभावी ढंग से चलाने में मदद मिलेगी।
बाल विकास कार्यक्रम को मजबूत करने से बिहार में बच्चों के स्वास्थ्य और शिक्षा में सुधार होगा, जिससे राज्य की बच्चों की स्थिति में सुधार होगा।

2026-08-07.title: APEDA Facilitates First-Ever Export of GI-tagged Mithila Makhana by Sea Route from Bihar to Australia
bullets: APEDA ne Bihar se Australia ke liye GI-tagged Mithila Makhana ka pehla samudri export kiya hai, jismein 18 Metric Tonnes ka consignment shamil hai
Is export ke liye 18 Metric Tonnes ka consignment BIADA Industrial Area, Bihta, Bihar se Australia ko bheja gaya hai, jiska financial outlay abhi tak nahin diya gaya hai
Yeh export APEDA Act 1985 ke tahat aata hai, jismein kisanon ko unke utpadon ke liye antarrashtriya bazaar mein pahunch banane mein madad milti hai

2026-08-07.title: Government signs strategic MoUs with key industry leaders and ecosystems to strengthen support to StartUps
bullets: DPIIT ne Cashfree Payments, Darwin Dynamics, Vultr India, Cars24 aur Council for Startup India ke saath MoU par sign kiye hain, jisse startups ko digital payment infrastructure aur fintech capabilities mein madad milegi
Is MoU ke tahat, DPIIT-recognised startups ko digital payment infrastructure aur fintech capabilities mein badhawa milega, lekin iske liye abhi tak koi financial outlay nahin diya gaya hai
Yeh MoU Startup India Mission ke tahat aata hai, jiska uddeshya startups ko samarthan dena aur unhein badhawa dena hai

2026-08-07.title: XI BRICS Culture Ministers’ Meeting Concludes in Bhopal; Bhopal Declaration Adopted

Is meeting mein BRICS Member States ke culture ministers ne bhag liya, lekin iske liye abhi tak koi financial outlay nahin diya gaya hai
Yeh meeting BRICS Summit ke tahat aati hai, jiska uddeshya BRICS Member States ke beech sahyog ko badhane mein madad karna hai

Homeowners Ka Kahna Hai Ki Tax Ke Karan Unki Personal Information Par Asar Pad Raha Hai
Pied-à-Terre Tax Ek Naya Tax Hai Jise New York City Mein Lagu Kiya Gaya Hai

2026-08-09.title: China slams India's move of formally naming 27 places in Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: India formally identified 27 places, including land, passes, a lake, and a monument, in Arunachal Pradesh by their standard names on the official Indian map.
China slammed India's move, calling it 'self-deception' that runs counter to improving bilateral relations and could complicate border issues.
The move is seen as a response to frequent attempts by China to rename similar places in the region.

2026-08-09.title: Kanwar Yatra 2026: Traffic restrictions in Delhi, U.P., and Haryana
bullets: The Kanwar Yatra, an annual pilgrimage of people from the Ganges River to their local temples, is underway and will conclude on August 11, 2026.
Traffic restrictions have been imposed in Delhi, U.P., and Haryana due to the large number of pilgrims traveling to and from the pilgrimage sites.
The pilgrimage began on July 30, 2026, and will conclude on the day of Shivratri.

2026-08-09.title: What happens if there is no Constitutional Amendment on Delimitation?
bullets: The BJP is keen to kick off a fresh delimitation of Lok Sabha constituencies and is trying to garner a two-thirds majority in Parliament to pass a Constitutional amendment.
The Centre has not revealed its exact proposals for delimitation, but the previous proposals included increasing the number of Lok Sabha seats.
The delimitation process is crucial for ensuring fair representation in Parliament and is a key aspect of the country's electoral system.

2026-08-09.title: Four detained for selling non-veg food on routes for Kanwariyas, shop razed in Bareilly
bullets: Police have detained four people for selling non-vegetarian food along designated Kanwar pilgrimage routes in Bareilly.
The action comes amid heightened police and administrative surveillance on Kanwar routes during the ongoing Sawan month.
Authorities have directed traders not to sell meat, chicken, fish, and other non-vegetarian food items along the pilgrimage routes.

2026-08-09.title: Delhi's forgotten Lodhi-era tombs: Inside Zamrudpur, where heritage stands amid homes and garbage
bullets: At least four Lodhi-era tombs listed by the Delhi government as Grade 1 heritage buildings have been found walled off by unplanned houses and garbage dumps in Zamrudpur.
The tombs were built by Zamrud Khan, an Afghan noble during the reign of Sikandar Lodhi in the late 15th century.
The decay of these tombs is a story of Delhi's neglect of its heritage and the need for better preservation and conservation efforts.

2026-08-09.title: India's US ambassador Vinay Mohan Kwatra debunks 'myths' on FCRA bill: 'Transparency, clearer rules'
bullets: India's ambassador to the US, Vinay Mohan Kwatra, has debunked five myths surrounding the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill (FCRA), 2026.
The bill aims to improve transparency, make way for better governance, and clearer rules for foreign contributions.
The ambassador stated that the bill will not target religions or NGOs' assets and will not cut off foreign aid to civil society.

2026-08-10.title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting eight essential qualities
bullets: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting eight essential qualities: Pragnya, Sushilata, Damau, Shruta, Parakrama, Bahubhashita, Dhan, and Kritajnata.
These eight qualities brighten a person's life, with Pragnya showing the right path, Sushilata keeping character pure, and Damau keeping one disciplined.
The qualities are based on ancient Indian wisdom and are considered essential for building character and achieving success in life.

2026-08-10.title: Gautam Adani denies any deal linked to dismissal of U.S. criminal case
bullets: Gautam Adani denied any deal linked to the dismissal of the U.S. criminal case in a sworn affidavit.
Adani stated that he was unaware of any exchange connected to the decision and denied knowledge of any agreement.
The U.S. Department of Justice's move to dismiss the criminal indictment against Adani has raised questions about the nature of the deal.

2026-08-10.title: India demands accountability after embassy premises defaced in Slovenian capital
bullets: The Indian embassy premises in Ljubljana, Slovenia were defaced allegedly by anti-India elements.
The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) has taken up the matter strongly with Slovenian authorities.
The MEA has demanded accountability for the perpetrators behind the reprehensible act.

2026-08-10.title: RSS to hold all-India coordination meeting in Andhra Pradesh
bullets: The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) will hold its annual Akhil Bharatiya Samanvay Baithak in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
The three-day meeting will bring together representatives of 32 organisations inspired by the RSS.
The meeting will be attended by national presidents, general secretaries, and other office-bearers of the organisations.

2026-08-10.title: History will remember Manmohan Singh kindly as most consequential PM: Sonia Gandhi
bullets: Congress leader Sonia Gandhi praised former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh for his record of integrity and accountability.
Gandhi stated that Singh's legacy will be remembered kindly by history as a quiet, gentle, but most consequential Prime Minister.
The Supreme Court's clean chit to Singh in the coal block allocation case has sparked a debate about his legacy.

2026-08-10.title: ‘Women aren’t birth machines’, CM Rekha Gupta defends Lakshmi Yojana
bullets: Chief Minister Rekha Gupta defended the Lakshmi Yojana scheme, which aims to empower women financially and improve their health.
Gupta stated that women should not be treated as 'machines for giving birth to children' and that family planning is a personal choice.
The scheme's eligibility conditions have been criticized by the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) for excluding women with more than three children.

2026-08-10.title: Full Vande Mataram to ring out from Red Fort for 1st time on Independence Day
bullets: The full rendition of Vande Mataram will be played at the Red Fort on Independence Day for the first time.
The decision was taken to promote national integration and patriotism.
The event will be attended by dignitaries and the public will be allowed to participate in the celebration.
